verdict.rationale: The evidence shows API keys for calling the same endpoints the web UI uses, an OpenAI-compatible gateway usable by any OpenAI-style client, and Python plugin Functions. None of these is an official SDK or client library published by Open WebUI: raw APIs and third-party OpenAI clients are building blocks, and plugins are an adjacent extension mechanism. No OpenAPI spec was found by the probe, and no official SDK is documented.
